caption: W.F. Denning. “Horary number of Perseïds.” From “The August Perseïds, 1877.” The Observatory 1 (September 1877): 164-166.
alt: A printed table of a night’s meteor watch in August 1877, giving the number of Perseids and other meteors seen in each half hour, with notes on the weather.
bibliography: Denning, W. F. "Horary Number of Perseïds." "The August Perseïds, 1877," The Observatory, vol. 1, Sept. 1877, pp. 164–166.
